message.content: the webhook keeps double-charging, fix it

content.text: The handler isn't idempotent. I'll key each delivery on the event id and store the first result, so a retry returns it instead of charging again.
Done. I also moved the write behind an outbox so the charge and the record commit together, which closes the dual-write gap.
One more: the queue consumer uses at-least-once delivery, so the idempotency key is what makes that safe. Nothing else to change.

message.content: what does at-least-once mean here exactly?

content.text: It means the broker may redeliver a message it already delivered if it never saw the ack, so handlers must tolerate duplicates.
